Extract from Pootoo Road Daily Report of 8.4.33

ASSISTANCE TO
S.P.S.B.
At 11.30 p.m. April 7, Detective Yai Yoong
Ching and others from the Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau Hqrs. brought to the station one Hong Tuh
Sung who had been arrested on 6.4.33 for distribu-
ting Communistic pamphlets in Chinese Territory,
No.6 Division, and requested assistance to arrest
two others who had been implicated by the arrested
man. The two wanted persons were arrested in the
Iung Hwa Li by D.S. Guess and C.D.C. 317 both accused
denied taking any active part in any Communisite
demonstrations, but admitted knowing Hong as a Communist
to introduce any person to him who wished to be of
service to him. Both the persons arrested by the
Settlement Police stated that they had been residents
in the Settlement for about one year and during this
period had been unemployed. As they were walking to
accompany the Detectives to Nantao for interrogation
and on the permission of the D.O."B" Division being
obtained, they were handed over to Shanghai Public Safety
Bureau representatives.

X O.C./S.B.
Please find out in a day or two whether they
have been detained.

F.W.G.
8/4/33.

Reg. Please attach to
file.
JHS

协助
上海市公安局。
4月7日晚上11时30分，来自上海市公安局总部的探员 Yai Yoong Ching 等人将一名洪德盛带到警局，此人因4月6日在中国地界第六区分发共产主义宣传册而被捕，并请求协助逮捕另外两名被该被捕者供出的人。这两名通缉人员由侦探警佐 Guess 和华籍巡捕 317 号在英华里逮捕，两名被告均否认积极参与任何共产主义示威活动，但承认认识洪是一名共产党人，并将任何希望为其效力的人介绍给他。这两名由租界警察逮捕的人声称，他们已在租界居住约一年，在此期间一直失业。在他们步行陪同探员前往南市接受讯问时，并在获得“B”分区值班警官的许可后，他们被移交给上海市公安局代表。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SPECIAL MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No: REGISTRY.
No. D 4745
Lootow Road Station,
Div "B"
Date 8th April 1933.

Subject (in full) Assistance to S.P.S.B. to arrest two suspected communists
in South Lung Hwa Li.

Made by D.S. Guess. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
I have to report that at 11.30 p.m. 7.4.1933 Detectives
from headquarters Shanghai Public Safety Bureau under Tai Yoong
Ching (戴永清) brought to this station one named Hong Tuh Sung
(洪德盛, who had been arrested on 6.4.1933 for distributing
communistic pamphlets in Chinese Territory in No.6 Division S.P.S.B.
During interrogation this man had implicated two others named:-
Tsang Ong Lai (陳恒來), age 22 years, Kompo, 3474 South Lung Hwa Li,
Au Sai Ts (房三子), 24 years, Kompo, 3530 South Lung Hwa Li.
and detectives requested assistance to arrest these two men.
The necessary assistance was rendered by D.S. Guess and C.D.C.317
and the 1st named was arrested at his home and on his information
the second named was located and arrested at his home.
Both accused were questioned at the station and stated
that they took no active part in any communistic demonstrations or
the like but knowing Hong Tuh Sung to be a communist introduced
any persons so inclined to him for service with the communist party.
Both accused stated that they had resided in the International
Settlement for about one year but had during this period been
unemployed. They were questioned and were willing to accompany
detectives to Nantao for interrogation and on the permission of
the D.O."B" Division being obtained they were finger printed and
handed over to S.P.S.B. representatives who promised to supply
photographs of both accused as soon as possible.

I am, Sir,
Your Obedient Servant.
[Signature]
D.S.263.

[Signature]
APR 11 1933
Sen.Det.I/c. [Signature]
D.D.O."B" Division.
Off.I/c. Special Branch.

日期 1933年4月8日。

主题（全称） 协助上海市公安局在南英华里逮捕两名涉嫌共产党分子。

由侦探警佐 Guess 制作。 由 [签名] 转发

致
局长阁下：
兹报告，1933年4月7日晚上11时30分，上海市公安局总部在戴永清 (Tai Yoong Ching) 率领下的探员将一名名为洪德盛 (Hong Tuh Sung) 的人带到本站，此人因1933年4月6日在上海市公安局第六分局中国地界分发共产主义宣传册而被捕。在审讯过程中，此人供出另外两人，名为：
曾恒来 (Tsang Ong Lai)，22岁，苦力，住南英华里3474号，
房三子 (Au Sai Ts)，24岁，苦力，住南英华里3530号。
探员请求协助逮捕这两人。
侦探警佐 Guess 和华籍巡捕317号提供了必要的协助，第一名嫌疑人在其家中被捕，并根据其提供的信息，第二名嫌疑人在其家中被找到并逮捕。
两名被告在警局受到讯问，并表示他们没有积极参与任何共产主义示威或类似活动，但因知道洪德盛是共产党人，便将任何有此倾向的人介绍给他，以为共产党服务。
两名被告均表示，他们已在国际租界居住约一年，但在此期间一直失业。经过讯问，他们愿意陪同探员前往南市接受讯问，在获得“B”分区值班警官的许可后，对他们进行了指纹采集，并移交给上海市公安局代表，后者承诺尽快提供两名被告的照片。

此致，
敬礼。
[签名]
侦探警佐 263号。

[签名]
1933年4月11日
高级探员主管 [签名]
“B”分区副值班警官。
特别股主管警官。

C O P Y

Headquarters,
Shanghai Municipal Police.
May 27, 1931.

Memo. to:-
Deputy Commissioner (Divisions)
Divisional Officers,
Divisional Detective Officers,
Officers i/c Police Stations.

With reference to Memo.262 issued on June 14, 1930,
under the Joint signatures of the Deputy Commissioner
(Divisions) and Deputy Commissioner (C.& S.Branches), the
following additional instructions, having in view the closer
co-operation of Station Detectives and the Special Branch,
are notified for guidance.

When a Communist or other political offender is arrested
or when information is obtained by Station Staffs about im-
portant occurrences connected with labour, communist or
political agitations the occurrence will be reported without
delay to the Special Branch. Arrangements have been made
whereby a member of the Special Branch will always be on duty,
outside ordinary office hours and the roster of officers on
this duty will be supplied to Stations at the end of each
month.

On receipt of a report of the above nature the Special
Branch will send officers to the Station concerned to assist
in the investigation and to render such other help as may be
required. In the event of any doubt as to subsequent pro-
cedure the matter will be referred to the Divisional Officer
or to the Officer i/c Special Branch.

The instructions contained in P.O. No.2367 and Memo.262
referred to above are in no way modified by these instructions.

R.M.J. Martin
Commissioner of Police.

副本

总部，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
1931年5月27日。

备忘录致：
副总监（各分区）
各区警官，
各区侦探警官，
各警局主管警官。

关于1930年6月14日由副总监（各分区）和副总监（刑事与特别股）联合签署发布的第262号备忘录，鉴于加强警局侦探与特别股之间的紧密合作，现通知以下补充指令以供遵循。

当逮捕共产党人或其他政治犯时，或当警局人员获得有关劳工、共产党或政治煽动的重要事件的情报时，应立即向特别股报告。已作出安排，确保在正常办公时间之外始终有一名特别股成员值班，每月月底将向各警局提供担任此职务的警官轮值表。

收到上述性质的报告后，特别股将派遣警官前往相关警局协助调查，并提供其他所需的帮助。如果对后续程序有任何疑问，应将此事提交给分区警官或特别股主管警官。

上述提及的第2367号警察命令和第262号备忘录中包含的指令不因本指令而有任何修改。

R.M.J. Martin
警察总监。

page_data.en:
C O P Y.

Police Order No. C. 2367 dated Nov. 18, 1930.

Copies of all reports concerning the matters mantioned
below will be forwarded to the Officer in charge of the Special
Branch and should reach Headquarters at the same time as the
Daily State.
(1) Arrest of persons on political or quasi political charges.
(2) Reports of Political demonstrations, strikes, agitation
connected with labour and social unrest.
(3) Irregular arrests by Chinese Authorities.
(4) Disputes between Settlement and Chinese Authorities of
any kind.
(5) Other matters of interest to Special Branch.
The reports should be as full and complete as possible
and be accompanied by literature, handbills or posters whenever
these are available.
When there is insufficient time to comply with the above
order and to avoid unnecessary delay the Officer in charge of the
Special Branch should be communicated with by telephone.
Detectives will seek and transmit information on the
above mentioned matters at all times.
page_data.zh:
副本。

1930年11月18日发布的警察命令第 C. 2367 号。

所有涉及下列事项的报告副本将送交特别股主管警官，并应与每日状况报告同时送达总部。
(1) 因政治或准政治指控逮捕人员。
(2) 有关政治示威、罢工、与劳工和社会动荡有关的煽动活动的报告。
(3) 中国当局的不规范逮捕。
(4) 租界与中国当局之间任何形式的纠纷。
(5) 特别股感兴趣的其他事项。
报告应尽可能详尽完整，并在有文献、传单或海报时一并附上。
当时间不足以遵守上述命令且为避免不必要的延误时，应通过电话与特别股主管警官联系。
侦探应随时搜集并传递上述事项的情报。

With reference to Memo.e262 issued on June 14, 1930, 
under the Joint signatures of the Deputy Commissioner 
(Divisions) and Deputy Commissioner (C.& S.eBranches), the 
following additional instructions, having in view the closer 
co-operation of Station Detectives and the Special Branch, 
are notified for guidance. 

When a Communist or other political offender is arrested 
or when information is obtained by Station Staffs about im- 
portant occurrences connected with labour, communist or 
political agitations the occurrence will be reported without 
delay to the Special Branch. Arrangements have been made 
whereby a member of the Special Branch will always be on duty,’ 
outside ordinary office hours and the roster of officers on ; 
this duty will be supplied to Stations at the end of each 
month. 

On receipt of a report of the above nature the Special 
Branch will send officers to the Station concerned to assist 


in the investigation and to render such other help as may be

Police Order No. C. 2367 dated Nov. 18, 19350. 


Copies of all reports concerning the matters mantioned 
below will be forwarded to the Officer in charge of the Special 
Branch and should reach Headquarters at the same time as the 
Daily State. 

(1) Arrest of persons on political or quasi political charges. 

(2) Reports of Political demonstrations, strikes, agitation 
connected with labour and social unrest. 

(3) Irregular arrests by Chinese Authorities. 

(4) Disputes between Settlement and Chinese Authorities of 
any kind. 

(5) Other matters of interest to Special Branch. 

The reports should be as full and complete as possible 
and be accompanied by literature, handbills or posters whenever 
these are available. 

When there is insufficient time to comply with the above 
order and to avoid unnecessary delay the Officer in charge of the 
Special Branch should be communicated with by telephone. 


Detectives will seek and transmit information on the 


above mentioned matters at all times.
